hardware_measurement_limit: This report examines source metadata and existing linker maps. It does not observe the CPU program counter or perform new hardware operations.

rx65n_copy_destination_assessment.classification: RAM code mapping absent in actual native build; runtime failure is not measured
rx65n_copy_destination_assessment.overlap_method: Parse every row in the MAP Mapping List (lines672-761); compare [copy_start,copy_end] against every nonzero [section_start,section_end], regardless of name or RAM classifier. A section of size0 does not reserve bytes. The separate RAM list covers on-chip RAM, extension RAM, and external SDRAM ranges from the linker CPU map; it includes zero-size entries.

normal_rx65n_map_followup.trace_selected_workspace: [local path omitted; repository-relative path or job id is recorded separately]
normal_rx65n_map_followup.main_44232_MCU_source_comparison: same for Projects/Common/Middleware git object trees
normal_rx65n_map_followup.result: MAP is not a normal CI artifact and no generated MAP remains at the trace-derived local workspace. No effective normal RAM mapping was established.

rx65n_OTA_bank_toggle_static_paths.scope: Two named production OTA entry paths; source inspection only, no runtime trace or PC observation
rx65n_OTA_bank_toggle_static_paths.ota_pal: otaPal_ActivateNewImage -> prvActivateBank; BSP_MCU_RX65N branch returns success and defers bank toggle to bootloader. Only RX72N/RX671 branch directly invokes R_FLASH_Control(FLASH_CMD_BANK_TOGGLE).
rx65n_OTA_bank_toggle_static_paths.legacy_fwup: R_FWUP_ActivateImage -> r_fwup_wrap_bank_swap -> FWUP_CFG_USER_BANK_SWAP_FUNCTION because FWUP_CFG_USER_BANK_SWAP_ENABLED=1 -> ota_bank_swap_function returns FWUP_SUCCESS without toggling. The generic wrapper direct BANK_TOGGLE call is in the inactive #else branch.
rx65n_OTA_bank_toggle_static_paths.driver_capability: FLASH_CMD_BANK_TOGGLE -> r_flash_control -> flash_toggle_banksel_reg exists when FLASH_IN_DUAL_BANK_MODE=1; existence is not proof that production RX65N OTA calls it.

rx671_boot_mapping_provenance_assessment.confirmed_effective: Existing job70882 linker command has PFRAM2=RPFRAM2; saved source .cproject does not. MAP places bank-selection routine in RAM.
rx671_boot_mapping_provenance_assessment.explicit_app_patch: Production make_ota_cproject inserts PFRAM2 mapping into the RX671 app; IDT calls this app transformation.
rx671_boot_mapping_provenance_assessment.checked_boot_IDT_actions: IDT reads boot .cproject original rom/start, saves boot .cproject, and rewrites boot/app .rcpc rom/start options. That code does not explicitly add PFRAM2 to the boot mapping.
rx671_boot_mapping_provenance_assessment.checked_boot_production_helper_actions: build_headless_rx671_bootloader.ps1 removes generated build directory, invokes e2 studio import/build, and restores two generator-properties files. No explicit linker mapping patch was found in that helper.
rx671_boot_mapping_provenance_assessment.causal_limit: The final linker command alone does not identify the stage adding the mapping. official_bank0_RAM_rationale.paraphrase: The official comment associates BANKSEL with bank0 and requires the RAM-resident function to poll until the operation completes even in BGO/interrupt mode, so execution does not return to bank0 while writing it.
